title: Disclose GenAI on First Session
content: Disclose plainly that the person is interacting with generative AI and not a human. When the disclosure is due depends on the Utah provision: on a clear request in a consumer transaction (§13-75-103(1)); at the start of a high-risk interaction in a regulated occupation (§13-75-103(2)-(3)); and for a mental health chatbot, before access, again after seven days without access, and whenever asked (§13-72a-203(2)). No Utah provision anchored here requires re-display at every session or after a fixed inactivity period.
